mechanism: Additive CNS depression and increased serotonergic activity from duloxetine combined with varenicline's neuropsychiatric effects; varenicline may inhibit CYP1A2 affecting duloxetine metabolism.
action: Monitor for increased CNS effects (dizziness, sedation, difficulty concentrating), mood changes, and suicidal ideation; counsel patients on avoiding driving until effects are known; consider baseline and periodic psychiatric assessment.
